interval.method: Split conformal, Mondrian by predicted-RUL band, out-of-fold CV residuals

protocol: Model and feature set selected by 5-fold engine-grouped cross-validation on the official training engines (five fixed-seed truncation points per held-out engine, uncapped truth, lowest MAE wins). 90% conformal intervals calibrated on the same out-of-fold residuals. Selected configuration refit on all 100 training engines, then evaluated once on the official 100 truncated test engines with supplied final-cycle RUL. Features are causal (current and earlier cycles only). Training targets capped at 125 cycles; evaluation truth uncapped unless labelled capped.
